title.en: Project Manager | Medical Imaging & Electromechanical Systems
title.zh: 專案經理｜醫療影像與機電系統

summary.en: Results-driven Project Manager with 10+ years of experience leading cross-functional teams in the end-to-end development of complex electromechanical systems and Class II/III medical devices.
summary.zh: 擁有 10 年以上經驗的結果導向專案經理，帶領跨部門團隊完成複雜機電系統與 II/III 類醫療器材的端到端開發。

summary.en: Specialized in medical imaging (endoscopy, imaging processor) and drug delivery systems, translating high-level requirements into executable engineering architectures.
summary.zh: 專精於醫療影像（內視鏡、影像處理器）與藥物遞送系統，能將高層需求轉化為可執行的工程架構。

summary.en: Hands-on across the full product lifecycle — concept, prototype, regulatory, design transfer and launch — with experience on both sides of the contract manufacturer/ODM relationship, including contributing to a CM's QMS build-up.
summary.zh: 具備完整產品生命週期的實務經驗——從概念、原型、法規、設計轉移到上市；並有合約製造商（CM）／ODM 雙方的工作經驗，包含參與 CM 的 QMS 建立。

summary.en: Experienced in people leadership: engineer interviewing and hiring, performance reviews and feedback, coaching and career development, and managing teams across regions.
summary.zh: 具備人員領導經驗：工程師面試與招募、績效評核與回饋、教練輔導與職涯發展，以及跨地區團隊管理。

summary.en: Proven track record in driving hardware feasibility, adhering to stringent Design Controls (FDA/MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 and IEC 60601), and managing global vendor strategies.
summary.zh: 具備推動硬體可行性、落實嚴謹設計管制（FDA/MDR、ISO 13485、ISO 14971、IEC 60601）及管理全球供應商策略的實績。

summary.en: Adept at building custom digital tools to streamline project execution and bridging communication between global stakeholders and large-scale manufacturing partners. Fluent in English and Mandarin.
summary.zh: 擅長自行開發數位工具以優化專案執行，並在全球利害關係人與大型製造夥伴之間搭起溝通橋樑。中英文流利。

text.en: Electromechanical System Development, Medical Imaging Systems, Product Development Lifecycle Management, product design and tradeoffs.
text.zh: 機電系統開發、醫療影像系統、產品開發生命週期管理、產品設計與取捨。

text.en: Cross-Functional Leadership, Schedule & Critical Path Management, Vendor/Supplier Management, Process Automation (Google Apps Script).
text.zh: 跨部門領導、時程與要徑管理、供應商管理、流程自動化（Google Apps Script）。

text.en: Design Control, Design History File (DHF), FDA/MDR, IEC 60601, ISO 13485, Risk Mitigation & Issue Resolution.
text.zh: 設計管制、設計歷史檔案（DHF）、FDA/MDR、IEC 60601、ISO 13485、風險緩解與問題解決。

text.en: Man-month forecasting (ME/EE/SW), resource conflict negotiation and prioritization, career-aware task assignment, competency-based reviews, interview scoring, cross-region team coordination.
text.zh: ME/EE/SW 人力工時預估、資源衝突協商與優先排序、考量職涯發展的任務分配、能力導向的績效評核、面試評分、跨地區團隊協調。

text.en: Multi-cavity plastic tooling, metal fabrication and surface treatment, yield improvement from design transfer through post-market surveillance.
text.zh: 多穴塑膠模具、金屬加工與表面處理、從設計轉移到上市後監督的良率改善。

tagline.en: Global leader in advanced drug delivery systems
tagline.zh: 先進藥物遞送系統全球領導者

bullets.en: Technical Issue Resolution: Provided tactical leadership during critical build phases; coordinated root-cause analysis with engineering teams to resolve a complex drug-leakage issue during the customer complaint process, mitigating project risks and keeping the schedule aligned.
bullets.zh: 技術問題解決：於關鍵製造階段提供戰術領導；協調工程團隊進行根因分析，解決客訴流程中的複雜藥液洩漏問題，降低專案風險並確保時程一致。

bullets.en: QMS Leadership & Compliance: Spearheaded the establishment of the department's Quality Management System (QMS) from the ground up. Partnered with Swiss HQ and a European consulting firm to build a new QMS for contract manufacturing on a medical device V-model, passing the Intertek audit. Led the migration of product technical files to FDA/MDR and Design Control standards.
bullets.zh: QMS 領導與合規：從零主導建立部門品質管理系統（QMS）；與瑞士總部及歐洲顧問公司密切合作，依醫療器材 V-model 為合約製造建立新的 QMS，並通過 Intertek 稽核；主導產品技術文件遷移，符合 FDA/MDR 與設計管制標準。

bullets.en: Process Improvement & Tooling: Independently developed and deployed a custom Project Tracking System (Python/Google Apps Script) to centralize sample tracking and cross-functional Lessons Learned databases.
bullets.zh: 流程改善與工具：獨立開發並部署專案追蹤系統（Python／Google Apps Script），集中管理樣品追蹤與跨部門經驗教訓資料庫。

bullets.en: Vendor Strategy & Negotiation: Evaluated in-house technical resource gaps and negotiated an outsourced tooling strategy with the CTO, achieving a 9x cost reduction by holding external suppliers accountable to development standards.
bullets.zh: 供應商策略與談判：評估內部技術資源缺口，與 CTO 協商外包模具策略，要求外部供應商遵循開發標準，達成 9 倍成本降低。

bullets.en: Tooling & Yield: Ran plastic tooling in parallel on every project, including multi-cavity molds (4+ cavities) for a 17-component auto-injector; raised post-production yield to ~90%.
bullets.zh: 模具與良率：每個專案皆同步進行塑膠模具開發，包含 17 個部件 autoinjector 的多穴模具（4 穴以上）；量產後良率提升至約 90%。

bullets.en: Global Team Coordination: Worked across a development team spanning the US, Switzerland, Sweden and Taiwan.
bullets.zh: 跨國團隊協作：與涵蓋美國、瑞士、瑞典、台灣的開發團隊協作。

tagline.en: Leading player in IoT and digital healthcare solutions
tagline.zh: 物聯網與數位醫療解決方案領導廠商

bullets.en: Technology Brainstorming: Led early technology brainstorming and architecture alignment for Intelligent Operating Room solutions and medical imaging displays (including C-arm X-ray), facilitating clear tradeoffs across cross-functional teams.
bullets.zh: 技術發想：主導智慧手術室解決方案與醫療影像顯示器（含 C-arm X 光）的早期技術發想與架構對齊，促成跨部門間清晰的取捨決策。

bullets.en: System Integration: Aligned internal R&D and external partners to ensure seamless electromechanical device integration with hospital IT systems while maintaining regulatory compliance.
bullets.zh: 系統整合：協調內部研發與外部夥伴，確保機電設備與醫院 IT 系統順暢整合並維持法規合規。

bullets.en: Strategic Investment & Architecture: Spearheaded a 4-person strategic task force to evaluate and secure internal corporate investment in an arm/mounting manufacturer (HiGrade), driving vertical integration of hardware solutions for operating rooms.
bullets.zh: 策略投資與架構：領導 4 人策略小組，評估並爭取公司內部對支臂／吊臂製造商（HiGrade）的投資，推動手術室硬體解決方案的垂直整合。

bullets.en: Global Team Coordination: Coordinated a development team across Korea, Taiwan and China, and a sales team across the US, the Netherlands (Europe), China, Israel (Middle East), Japan, Korea and India.
bullets.zh: 跨國團隊協調：協調涵蓋韓國、台灣、中國的開發團隊，以及涵蓋美國、荷蘭（歐洲）、中國、以色列（中東）、日本、韓國、印度的銷售團隊。

tagline.en: Medical device design and manufacturing service provider
tagline.zh: 醫療器材設計與製造服務供應商

bullets.en: Class III Hardware Development: Drove end-to-end hardware development of a Class III insulin pump, ensuring strict adherence to Design Control, ISO 13485 and IEC 60601, and overseeing the release process for parts and assemblies.
bullets.zh: III 類硬體開發：主導 III 類胰島素幫浦的端到端硬體開發，嚴格遵循設計管制、ISO 13485 與 IEC 60601，並監督零組件與組裝件的發行流程。

bullets.en: Imaging Product Execution: Directed cross-functional development (EE, ME, SW) of disposable endoscopy imaging systems; held decision-making authority on technical conflicts and kept teams accountable for key decision milestones.
bullets.zh: 影像產品執行：指揮拋棄式內視鏡影像系統的跨部門開發（電子、機構、軟體）；對技術衝突擁有決策權，並要求團隊達成關鍵決策里程碑。

bullets.en: Manufacturing & Build Phases: Managed design transfer with R&D and process engineers during build phases across a 5,000+ employee manufacturing site, coordinating with Supply Chain and Engineering on build quantities and configurations to ensure scalable production.
bullets.zh: 製造與試產階段：於 5,000 人以上的製造廠區，與研發及製程工程師管理設計轉移，並與供應鏈及工程協調試產數量與配置，確保可量產擴展。

bullets.en: Yield & Metal Parts: Managed metal structural parts, stainless steel housings and surface treatment/painting; raised insulin pump assembly yield from ~60% to 85% and endoscopy yield to ~90%.
bullets.zh: 良率與金屬件：管理金屬結構件、不鏽鋼外殼及表面處理／噴漆；胰島素幫浦組裝良率由約 60% 提升至 85%，內視鏡良率提升至約 90%。

bullets.en: Requirements Engineering: Led customer-facing requirements definition, translating ambiguous clinical concepts into executable hardware and system specifications.
bullets.zh: 需求工程：主導面向客戶的需求定義，將模糊的臨床概念轉化為可執行的硬體與系統規格。

desc.zh: 同步開發多達 17 個部件之 autoinjector 的多穴塑膠模具；每個專案皆包含塑膠模具開發。

desc.en: Managed structural metal parts (e.g., middle frame, PCBA holder), stainless steel housings, surface treatment and painting.
desc.zh: 管理金屬結構件（如 middle frame、PCBA holder）、不鏽鋼外殼，以及表面處理與噴漆。

desc.en: Advantech: development team across Korea, Taiwan and China; sales team across the US, the Netherlands (Europe), China, Israel (Middle East), Japan, Korea and India. SHL Medical: development team across the US, Switzerland, Sweden and Taiwan.
desc.zh: Advantech：開發團隊涵蓋韓國、台灣、中國；銷售團隊涵蓋美國、荷蘭（歐洲）、中國、以色列（中東）、日本、韓國、印度。SHL Medical：開發團隊涵蓋美國、瑞士、瑞典、台灣。
